subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When the operator, or a driver acting for the operator, starts a new feature, the system shall open one feature draft for it that holds its PRD and tech spec with their brainstorm records and review reports.
rationale: One workspace holds the whole contract (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-1, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-2)
fit_criterion: A new-feature fixture yields exactly one open draft whose PRD, tech spec, brainstorm records, and review reports are each addressable, and zero document-pipeline artifacts.
